notes:
New Features:

- Experimental Dorcel predictive refresh is enabled for 15-minute and 30-minute Channels Checks. It waits for two qualifying stall clusters roughly 270-330 seconds apart before confirming the cycle, then prepares a fresh Dorcel session and performs the handoff about 12 seconds before the next predicted stall.

Improvements:

- All Channels Checks now save the Kodi log automatically at completion.
- Save Log Only is shown only for 1 h and 2 h checks; 15-minute and 30-minute checks save the log automatically without showing the option.
- The 1 h/2 h end-action selection is preserved when running shorter checks.
- Shutdown is now labeled simply Shutdown because log saving is automatic for every timing.

Important:

- The predictive Dorcel refresh remains restricted to short 15/30-minute tests for controlled validation. Existing token-handoff safety logic remains active.
- One Channel playback, Check Lock, 65/125-minute timing, AlarmClock/watchdog, log-copy implementation and shutdown implementation remain otherwise unchanged.
